field.label: Enable site connector
field.help: Connects this OPNsense firewall as a Pangolin site. Local resources are exposed through Pangolin's resource/proxy model. The site connector is independent of the machine client.

field.label: Site secret
field.help: Stored in config.xml (root-readable) and written to a 0600 agent configuration file.

field.label: Site name
field.help: Optional display name sent to Pangolin.

field.label: Interface name
field.help: Only used when native main-interface mode is enabled. The default user-space netstack mode needs no TUN device.

field.label: Netstack resolver
field.help: Resolver used by the site connector's internal netstack. Unbound remains the LAN resolver.

field.label: Use native TUN interface
field.help: Runs the site tunnel through a FreeBSD tun(4) interface instead of the user-space netstack. Requires root (the service already runs as root) and is intended for advanced deployments.

field.label: Disable Newt SSH/auth daemon
field.help: Recommended: the site connector on a firewall does not need Newt's SSH auth daemon.

field.label: Disable downstream WireGuard clients
field.help: Recommended: the firewall is a site connector, not a downstream client hub.
